recommendation: Keep the commit. It completes the remaining current-source pieces of the published FHIR-26601 decision without reintroducing inactive ChargeItem/Statement references. Future capitation-specific additions should wait for a final disposition of FHIR-53869 or a successor issue.
issue_request: FHIR-26601 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5. It asked to keep PaymentReconciliation while expanding its scope to payments made on behalf of patients, add payment source/workflow/method and allocation elements, rename paymentDate/paymentAmount/detail to date/amount/allocation, replace allocation.request with allocation.target, adjust allocation cardinalities and response type, add target/account/encounter search support, and update supporting text and examples.
initial_application: Generic August 2022 PaymentReconciliation commits ffa7a1ee67 and 161b0f1ce1 applied most structural pieces: the new payment type/kind/issuer elements and terminology, paymentIssuer Patient/RelatedPerson support, renamed date/amount/allocation elements, allocation.target/targetItem/account/encounter, optional allocation.type, ClaimResponse allocation.response, updated examples, and account/encounter search parameters. They did not tag FHIR-26601, left allocation.target at 0..1, did not add a target search parameter, and left current narrative focused on payor/insurance bulk payments.
additional_context: FHIR-32786 is a final no-change decision not to rename PaymentReconciliation to FinancialTransaction; FHIR-15126 says the R5 PaymentReconciliation changes from FHIR-26601 address payment posting needs; Zulip and PA minutes confirm the patient-payment and credit-card/online-payment motivation; FHIR-40279 later removed Person from paymentIssuer while keeping Patient and RelatedPerson; and FHIR-53869 is a later Triaged R6 capitation-support request that is not final enough to decide here. ChargeItem was removed from the current build in 71567db3ee and Statement is not an active current resource, so those historical target choices were not restored.
reconciliation: Changed build-scope PaymentReconciliation source: allocation.target is now 1..1; PaymentReconciliation-target searches allocation.target; the existing request search parameter description now describes the top-level original request rather than a claim; scope/boundary text now covers insurer/payor and patient-collected payments; the existing example's advance allocation now has an Account target; and a patient-payment example was added and registered.
source_changes: source/paymentreconciliation/bundle-PaymentReconciliation-search-params.xml: added PaymentReconciliation-target for allocation.target and clarified the existing request search parameter description.
source/paymentreconciliation/paymentreconciliation-introduction.xml: updated Scope/Usage and Boundaries wording to include patient-collected payments as well as insurer/payor payments.
source/paymentreconciliation/paymentreconciliation-example.xml: added an Account target to the existing advance allocation so it conforms to target 1..1.
source/paymentreconciliation/paymentreconciliation-example-patient.xml: added a patient online-payment example using issuerType=patient and allocation.account/target.

related_jiras.note: Resolved - No Change decision explains why PaymentReconciliation was not renamed to FinancialTransaction despite the original FHIR-26601 request.

Published R5 correction removed Person from paymentIssuer while preserving Patient and RelatedPerson support.
Later Triaged R6 request for capitation-related support is not final and remains outside this reconciliation.
Financial module roadmap context confirms payment-related resource focus and future FIAB/statement work.
